listing.name: OpenTTD / OpenTTD-patches (JGRennison)
listing.summary: Explore OpenTTD / OpenTTD-patches (JGRennison) and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Install or keep your existing copy
steps.instruction: Install uses the official portable runtime with updates managed by Portcove. Installation options retain a non-owning route for an existing, upstream-managed or customized copy.

steps.title: Start the game
steps.instruction: On first Play, choose a base graphics set when requested. Upstream supports the free OpenGFX/OpenSFX/OpenMSX sets or your own compatible original Transport Tycoon Deluxe data. JGR Patch Pack is a separate game build, not a loadable mod; its saves and multiplayer peers must be compatible with that build.

steps.title: Keep your progress
steps.instruction: The default Windows save/config/content location is Documents/OpenTTD, shared with other OpenTTD copies and outside Portcove backups. Only the named fallback configs, saves, scenarios, heightmaps, order lists, NewGRF files, screenshots and content_download folder are declared if present. Packaged baseset, ai and game resources remain immutable. Use an external registration for a mixed executable-folder custom profile or plugins; unknown additions keep their exact-path preservation guard. Portcove replaces this runtime only; it does not manage external shared saves, original game files or another OpenTTD installation. Older runtimes may not read newer saves.
